title: Chargers open 21-day practice window for LB Denzel Perryman

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Chargers open 21-day practice window for LB Denzel Perryman
sources.description: The Chargers opened the 21-day practice window for tight end David Njoku and linebacker Denzel Perryman, coach Jim Harbaugh announced Wednesday.
